name: How can I tell if my door jamb needs repair or full replacement?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my door jamb needs repair or full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: To determine if your door jamb needs repair or full replacement, inspect the wood for softness, discoloration, or crumbling, particularly near the bottom. If the damage is superficial and confined to a small area, a repair might be sufficient. However, if the rot has spread deep into the wood, affects structural integrity, or extends significantly up the frame, a full replacement is often more cost-effective and provides a lasting solution. Maine Results, Inc. assesses the extent of the damage to advise on the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for soft, discolored, or crumbling wood. Minor surface rot may be repairable, but widespread or deep damage usually requires a full replacement for structural integrity.
